title: Guarded Canary Scoped Enablement Executor Extension
claim: FP-MCP-316 should extend forgepilot_apply_guarded_canary_next_gate by exactly one guarded stage: when a valid scoped approval and valid operator-local clearance already exist for the FP-MCP-295 canary tuple, the enforced executor may internally preview and create scoped execution enablement, then stop before runner start.
summary: This packet is the next implementation target after FP-MCP-315. It should preserve the narrowed action surface and prevent operator selection of adjacent manual enablement tools by routing the next enablement gate through the sequencer-selected enforced executor path only. The extension must not contact runner start, consume approval, start OpenCode, or run the canary.
caveats: This is a packet proposal/checkpoint for the next implementation target, not the implementation itself.
Any FP-MCP-315 clearance must be treated as expired and not reused.
Runner start remains explicitly out of scope for FP-MCP-316.
boundaries: Must not contact the runner start endpoint.
Must not create or expose broad/standing enablement.
Must not proceed beyond scoped enablement creation.
Must keep adjacent manual enablement tools hidden from the default narrowed action surface.

inputPreconditions: fresh scoped approval for the FP-MCP-295 tuple
valid operator-local clearance for the same tuple

observedResult: FP-MCP-316 should extend forgepilot_apply_guarded_canary_next_gate by exactly one guarded stage: when a valid scoped approval and valid operator-local clearance already exist for the FP-MCP-295 canary tuple, the enforced executor may internally preview and create scoped execution enablement, then stop before runner start.
